abilities.name: Evade 1 Ability
abilities.description: The percent chance to dodge enemy swings. If the character's class has access to the increased versions of this ability, it will progress naturally as they level.  Evasion is a frontal-arc ability and only works against attacks that are coming from the front.

abilities.description: Provides a player with the ability to "take one for the team." With this skill, the player may choose one person to Intercept and take the damage, without armor considerations, that would have hit the protected player.  The target must be within melee range.
